#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 21 detailed analysis — conversion, billing, competitor, churn."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# --- Daily conversion by group/source days 141-147 ---
print("\n========== LEADS / CONV d141-147 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.created_day AS day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
    ORDER BY c.created_day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    leads = row["leads"]
    sub = row["ever_sub"]
    lost = row["lost"]
    conv = 100.0 * sub / leads if leads else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['group_id']:3} {row['acquisition_source']:20} leads={leads:4} sub={sub:3} lost={lost:3} conv={conv:5.1f}%")

print("\n========== S1 NETWORK DAILY ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.created_day AS day,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 134 AND 147
      AND c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY c.created_day ORDER BY c.created_day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['ever_sub']:3}/{row['leads']:3} = {conv:5.1f}%")

# --- New first bills this week ---
print("\n========== PAYMENTS d141-147 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger
    WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger
    WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
""")
print("TOTAL PAYMENTS W21:", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt
""")
print("\n--- LEDGER W21 ---")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# --- Active book listed vs effective ---
print("\n========== ACTIVE BOOK PRICES ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# --- Next-week billing face (d148-154) from current subscribed ---
print("\n========== BILLING CALENDAR (subscribed, next 4 weeks) ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 28 AND 29 OR (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 THEN 'd148-154'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'd155-161'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 12 AND 18 THEN 'd162-168'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 19 AND 25 THEN 'd169-175'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS bucket,
      s.plan,
      COUNT(*) AS n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.listed_price > 9 AND s.plan='A' THEN 9.0
               WHEN s.listed_price > 39 AND s.plan='B' THEN 39.0
               ELSE s.listed_price END) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY bucket, s.plan
    ORDER BY bucket, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# More precise: next bill day
print("\n========== NEXT BILL BY DAY (d148-175) ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) = 0 THEN 150
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) <= 4 THEN 150 + (s.start_day % 30)
        ELSE 120 + (s.start_day % 30)
      END AS approx_wrong,
      (s.start_day % 30) AS mod30,
      s.plan,
      COUNT(*) AS n,
      SUM(MIN(s.listed_price, CASE s.plan WHEN 'A' THEN 9.0 WHEN 'B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END)) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY (s.start_day % 30), s.plan
    ORDER BY (s.start_day % 30), s.plan
""")
# Better: compute next billing day from start_day
print("(raw mod30 below)")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT (s.start_day % 30) AS mod30, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (147 - s.start_day) BETWEEN 28 AND 34 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_renew_ish,

           SUM(CASE WHEN (147 - s.start_day) BETWEEN 88 AND 94 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t90_ish
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY (s.start_day % 30), s.plan
    ORDER BY (s.start_day % 30), s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== FIRST-RENEW / TENURE COHORTS THAT BILLED d141-147 ==========")
# billing day = start_day + 30k, so those with start_day in 111-117 billed first-renew this week
# tenure-60: start 81-87; tenure-90: 51-57; tenure-120: 21-27
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 111 AND 117 THEN 'first_renew_111-117'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 81 AND 87 THEN 't60_81-87'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 51 AND 57 THEN 't90_51-57'

        ELSE 'other_billed'
      END AS cohort,
      s.plan, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n

import json

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# --- Cancellations this week ---
print("\n========== CANCELS d141-147 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.end_day AS day, c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           AVG(s.end_day - s.start_day) AS avg_tenure,
           MIN(s.end_day - s.start_day) AS min_t,
           MAX(s.end_day - s.start_day) AS max_t
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    GROUP BY s.end_day, c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY s.end_day, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== CANCELS BY TENURE BUCKET ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN (s.end_day - s.start_day) BETWEEN 28 AND 34 THEN 'first_renew~30'
        WHEN (s.end_day - s.start_day) BETWEEN 58 AND 64 THEN 'tenure~60'
        WHEN (s.end_day - s.start_day) BETWEEN 88 AND 94 THEN 'tenure~90'
        WHEN (s.end_day - s.start_day) BETWEEN 118 AND 124 THEN 'tenure~120'
        ELSE 'other_' || CAST(s.end_day - s.start_day AS TEXT)
      END AS bucket,
      s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    GROUP BY bucket, s.plan
    ORDER BY bucket, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== FIRST-RENEW COHORT start 111-117 OUTCOME ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n,
           AVG(s.end_day - s.start_day) AS avg_ten

    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 111 AND 117
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.plan, s.status
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# How many of start 111-117 cancelled THIS week
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id

    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("first-renew cancelled THIS week:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 111 AND 117
      AND s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("first-renew still subscribed:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# How many were subscribed at start of week (end of d140)?
# Anyone who cancelled before 141 is already cancelled; those who were subscribed at d140
# = currently subscribed OR cancelled with end_day>=141
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 111 AND 117
      AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>=141))

""")
print("first-renew were-alive at d141:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== NEW SUBS THIS WEEK (first bills) ==========")
r = nm.query("""

           SUM(s.listed_price) AS listed, SUM(s.effective_price) AS eff

    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id

      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS first_bill
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("NEW FIRST-BILL TOTALS:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== S1 B STOCK CHANGE ==========")
# start of week S1 B was 164. Now 155. New B + cancels + silent B->A
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_B,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_B,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS now_B
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='B'
""")
print("S1 B identity:", r.get("rows"))

# Silent B->A: customers who had B and now have A
# Dashboard said 14 downgrades, 2 upgrades

print("\n========== PLAN MIX OF NEW CONVERTERS ==========")
r = nm.query("""

print("\n========== ISSUES BACKLOG ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT

        WHEN days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '7-13d'
        ELSE '14d+'
      END AS bucket,
      COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM issues WHERE status='open'
    GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(days_open) AS avg_open FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
print("open total", r.get("rows"))

# Daily open/resolve last 14d
print("\n========== ISSUES OPEN/RESOLVE LAST 14d ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT open_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS opened
    FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN 134 AND 147
    GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day
""")
print("opened:", r.get("rows"))
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT resolved_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS resolved
    FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 134 AND 147
    GROUP BY resolved_day ORDER BY resolved_day
""")
print("resolved:", r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== TARGETED SPEND / ADS / PROMO ==========")
print("overview keys check via market + marketing")
# ads
r = nm.query("SELECT day, channel_id, group_id, leads_generated, spend FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 141 AND 147")
print("ad_channel_leads W21:", r.get("rows"))

# confirm targeted
print("\nget_market_overview already done")

# S3 usage
print("\n========== S3 ACTIVE USAGE ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan, s.listed_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S3' AND s.status='subscribed'
""")
print("S3 subs:", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT d.day, d.customer_id, d.usage_units
    FROM daily_usage d
    JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=d.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=d.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S3' AND d.day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    ORDER BY d.customer_id, d.day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== E GHOSTS W21 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT created_day, group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM customers
    WHERE group_id IN ('E1','E2','E3') AND created_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147
    GROUP BY created_day, group_id
""")
print(r.get("rows"))
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers
    WHERE group_id IN ('E1','E2','E3')
    GROUP BY group_id
""")
print("lifetime E:", r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== LIFETIME S1 ==========")

      COUNT(*) AS leads
    FROM customers c WHERE c.group_id='S1'
""")

        day = p.get("day") or p.get("created_day") or p.get("post_day")
        src = p.get("source_group_id") or p.get("group_id")
        pid = p.get("post_id") or p.get("id")
        print(f"d{day} {src} #{pid}: {text[:220]}")

print("\n========== ALL POST KEYS SAMPLE ==========")
if plist:
    print(list(plist[0].keys()))
    print(plist[0])

print("\n========== POST COUNTS BY DAY ==========")
from collections import Counter
c = Counter()
for p in plist:
    c[p.get("day") or p.get("created_day")] += 1
for d in sorted(c):
    print(d, c[d])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""W21: next-week cohorts, billing faces, spend state, social recent, S1 lifetime by week."""
import novamind_api as nm
import json

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

print("\n========== NEXT WEEK FIRST-RENEW start 118-124 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 118 AND 124
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("first-renew 118-124:", r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== TENURE-60 start 88-94 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 88 AND 94
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== TENURE-90 start 58-64 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 58 AND 64
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== TENURE-120 start 28-34 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 28 AND 34
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== TENURE-150 start 0-4? wait start -3 to 4 = days 0-4 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(s.start_day) AS mn, MAX(s.start_day) AS mx
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 0 AND 4
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("start 0-4 (would be ~t150 if they exist):", r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== EXACT NEXT-BILL FACE d148-175 ==========")
# next bill day = start_day + 30 * ceil((147+1-start_day)/30) wait
# For a customer, next billing day > 147 is start_day + 30*k where k = ceil((148-start_day)/30)
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      (s.start_day + 30 * CAST(((148 - s.start_day + 29) / 30) AS INT)) AS next_bill,
      s.plan,
      COUNT(*) AS n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY next_bill, s.plan
    ORDER BY next_bill, s.plan
""")
# SQLite integer division: (148-start+29)/30 = ceil((148-start)/30) for positive
print("Trying integer formula...")
for row in (r.get("rows") or [])[:40]:
    print(row)

print("\n========== WEEKLY FACE BUCKETS BY MOD30 ==========")
# d148-154: mods 28,29,0,1,2,3,4
# d155-161: mods 5-11
# d162-168: mods 12-18
# d169-175: mods 19-25
# d176-182: mods 26,27 + leftover? 26,27 then 28...
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) IN (28,29,0,1,2,3,4) THEN 'W22_d148-154'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'W23_d155-161'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 12 AND 18 THEN 'W24_d162-168'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 19 AND 25 THEN 'W25_d169-175'
        WHEN (s.start_day % 30) IN (26,27) THEN 'W26_d176-177_partial'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS wk,
      s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY wk, s.plan
    ORDER BY wk, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== W21 EXISTING vs NEW PAYMENT IDENTITY ==========")
# payments 9150, new 978, existing 8172, start face 9285, collect 88.01%
print("computed earlier: pay 9150, new 978, existing 8172, face 9285, collect 88.0%")

print("\n========== S1 NETWORK CONV BY CREATED WEEK ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CAST((c.created_day) / 7 AS INT) AS wk,
      MIN(c.created_day) AS d0, MAX(c.created_day) AS d1,
      COUNT(*) AS leads,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY wk
    ORDER BY wk
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  W{row['wk']} d{row['d0']}-{row['d1']} {row['ever']}/{row['leads']} = {conv:.1f}%")

print("\n========== LIFETIME S1 BY CHANNEL ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.acquisition_source,
      COUNT(*) AS leads,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost'
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY c.acquisition_source
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  {row['acquisition_source']:20} {row['ever']}/{row['leads']} lost={row['lost']} conv={conv:.1f}%")

print("\n========== RECENT SOCIAL d136-147 (non-competitor sample) ==========")
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=12, limit=80)
plist = posts["posts"]
for p in plist:
    if p["day"] >= 136:
        print(f"d{p['day']} g={p.get('group_id')} src={p.get('source_group_id')} {p['content'][:160].replace(chr(10),' ')}")

print("\n========== ENTERPRISE TURNS ANY ==========")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN closed=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_n FROM enterprise_turns")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== ADS STRENGTH / PROMO via trying APIs ==========")
# read marketing.json? just print cost info and try get functions
print(nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info())

    SELECT
      COALESCE((
        SELECT s.status FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id
        ORDER BY s.start_day DESC LIMIT 1
      ), 'no_sub') AS st,
      COUNT(*) AS n_issues,
      COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_id) AS n_cust
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open' AND i.days_open >= 14

""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN days_open=0 THEN '0d'
        WHEN days_open=1 THEN '1d'
        WHEN days_open BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN '2-6d'
        WHEN days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '7-13d'
        ELSE '14d+'
      END AS bucket,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT s.status FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id
        ORDER BY s.start_day DESC LIMIT 1
      ), 'no_sub') AS st,
      COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open'

    ORDER BY bucket, st
""")
print("\nall open by age x status:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:

The live subscriber open issues...I think the $200 S1 targeted ops is still worth keeping for now. Even though the 14d+ backlog is all cancelled customers, the 2-6 94 is still multi-day waits that could drive complaints. Cutting to $100 or $0 would save $1,400/week, but it risks turning some of those 94 into longer waits or even cancellations if resolution slows down.

The resolve rate of ~410/d with $200 is keeping pace with opens for live customers 0-1 day and 2-6 day buckets. If I cut ops, the resolution rate drops, and those 94 could start aging into 7-13d or worse, which would hurt the avg_open for live subscribers. The cancelled customer zombies inflating the overall avg_open to 5.03d is 124 issues, but the dashboard shows 649 live, so the 2-6d are the ones we need to watch.

The cash runway is about 32 weeks at current bleed, but that's assuming no changes. With $200 ops, we're holding steady. If I cut, I might need to monitor resolution rate 2-3 weeks to see if live issues start aging faster. The memory note about not panicking on outages is good, but the 2-6d live backlog is the real risk.

I think the best move is to hold at $200 for now, watch the 2-6d bucket closely, and 2 weeks from now if the 2-6d drops below 50 or resolution rate improves, then consider cutting to $100. That way we get the benefit of the $200 without committing to it long term. The quality gap is still there, and the S1 bonus is helping, so keeping the ops spend 2 weeks is low risk.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 22 detailed analysis — conversion, billing, competitor, churn, issues."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# --- Daily conversion by group/source days 148-154 ---
print("\n========== LEADS / CONV d148-154 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.created_day AS day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
    GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
    ORDER BY c.created_day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    leads = row["leads"]
    sub = row["ever_sub"]
    lost = row["lost"]
    conv = 100.0 * sub / leads if leads else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['group_id']:3} {row['acquisition_source']:20} leads={leads:4} sub={sub:3} lost={lost:3} conv={conv:5.1f}%")

print("\n========== S1 NETWORK DAILY d134-154 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.created_day AS day,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 134 AND 154
      AND c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY c.created_day ORDER BY c.created_day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['ever_sub']:3}/{row['leads']:3} = {conv:5.1f}%")

print("\n========== S1 NETWORK WEEKLY ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 148 AND 154 THEN 'W22'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147 THEN 'W21'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 134 AND 140 THEN 'W20'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 127 AND 133 THEN 'W19'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS wk,
      COUNT(*) AS leads,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
          WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 127 AND 154
      AND c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY wk ORDER BY wk
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  {row['wk']} {row['ever_sub']}/{row['leads']} = {conv:.1f}%  mean_leads/d={row['leads']/7:.1f}")

# --- Payments this week ---
print("\n========== PAYMENTS d148-154 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger
    WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
    GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger
    WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
""")
print("TOTAL PAYMENTS W22:", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
    GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt
""")
print("\n--- LEDGER W22 ---")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS net
    FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
    GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
""")
print("\n--- DAILY NET W22 ---")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# --- Active book listed vs effective ---
print("\n========== ACTIVE BOOK PRICES ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# --- New first bills vs existing ---
print("\n========== NEW FIRST-BILLS vs EXISTING d148-154 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 148 AND 154 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 148 AND 154 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS new_amt,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day < 148 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exist_n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day < 148 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS exist_amt
    FROM ledger l
    JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = l.subscription_id
    WHERE l.category='subscription_payment' AND l.day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

# Check ledger columns
print("\n========== LEDGER SAMPLE ==========")
r = nm.query("SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day=148 LIMIT 3")
print(r.get("rows"))

for row in r.get("rows") or []:

           CASE

    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, bucket

""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== FIRST-RENEW COHORT start 118-124 STILL ALIVE? ==========")
# Those who would have billed first-renew this week
r = nm.query("""

for row in r.get("rows") or []:

"""Week 22 analysis 3 — issues live/zombie, competitor, billing calendar, spend, E."""
import novamind_api as nm
import json
import re

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# --- LIVE vs ZOMBIE issues ---
print("\n========== ISSUES LIVE vs ZOMBIE ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
      ) THEN 'live' ELSE 'zombie' END AS kind,
      CASE
        WHEN i.days_open = 0 THEN '0d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 1 THEN '1d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 2 THEN '2d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 3 THEN '3d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 4 THEN '4d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 5 THEN '5d'
        WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 6 AND 6 THEN '6d'
        WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '7-13d'
        ELSE '14d+'
      END AS age,
      COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open'
    GROUP BY kind, age
    ORDER BY kind, age
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
      ) THEN 'live' ELSE 'zombie' END AS kind,
      COUNT(*) AS n,
      AVG(i.days_open) AS avg_open,
      MAX(i.days_open) AS max_open
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open'
    GROUP BY kind
""")
print("SUMMARY", r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== ISSUE OPENS/RESOLVES d148-154 ==========")

    SELECT open_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS opens

if isinstance(ov, dict):

    for k in ["ads_strength", "promotions", "targeted_ad_spend", "targeted_ops_spend", "targeted_dev_spend", "daily_spend"]:
        if k in ov:
            print(k, ov[k])

# --- Enterprise ---
print("\n========== ENTERPRISE ==========")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print("open threads", r.get("rows"))
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id LIKE 'E%' AND c.created_day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
    GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
print("new E leads W22", r.get("rows"))
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id LIKE 'E%'
    GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
print("lifetime E", r.get("rows"))

# --- Billing calendar going forward from day 154 ---
print("\n========== BILLING FACE NEXT 4 WEEKS (subscribed now) ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 AS mod30, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30, s.plan
    ORDER BY s.billing_day_mod30, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== NEXT BILL DAY DISTRIBUTION ==========")
# next bill = next day d where d % 30 == billing_day_mod30, d > 154
# days 155-161, 162-168, 169-175, 176-182
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'd155-161'
        WHEN s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 12 AND 18 THEN 'd162-168'
        WHEN s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 19 AND 25 THEN 'd169-175'
        WHEN s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 26 AND 29 OR s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN 'd176-182'
        ELSE 'other_mod_' || CAST(s.billing_day_mod30 AS TEXT)
      END AS bucket,
      s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY bucket, s.plan
    ORDER BY bucket, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n========== FIRST-RENEW / TENURE THAT BILL NEXT WEEK d155-161 ==========")
# next week billing days 155-161. billing_day_mod30 of those days:

"""Week 22 analysis 4 — competitor social, collect identity, S3 usage, ads, quality."""
import novamind_api as nm
import re
import json

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# Social posts last 14 days

    content = p.get("content") or p.get("text") or ""

    gid = p.get("source_group_id") or p.get("group_id")

    low = content.lower()
    if any(k in low for k in ["competitor", "rival", "launched", "quality +", "boost", "upgrade", "new model", "just shipped", "beats"]):
        print(f"  d{day} g={gid} a={author}: {content[:220]}")
    nums = num_re.findall(content)
    # quality-boost style numbers typically 0.00x - 0.10
    interesting = [n for n in nums if 0.005 <= float(n) <= 0.20]
    if interesting:
        print(f"  NUM d{day} g={gid} nums={interesting}: {content[:200]}")

print("\n========== ALL POSTS LAST 10 DAYS (compact) ==========")
# sort
def pday(p):
    return p.get("day") or p.get("created_day") or p.get("post_day") or 0
recent = [p for p in plist if pday(p) >= 145]
recent.sort(key=pday)
print("recent count", len(recent))
# print unique contents to spot competitor
seen = set()
for p in recent:
    c = (p.get("content") or "")[:180]

for row in r.get("rows") or []:

""")
rows = r.get("rows") or []
print("payment rows", len(rows), "sum", sum(x["amount"] for x in rows))

# extract ids
ids = []
for x in rows:
    m = re.search(r"customer (\d+)", x["note"] or "")
    if m:
        ids.append((int(m.group(1)), x["amount"], x["day"]))
print("parsed", len(ids))

# classify new vs existing via start_day
# do in batches
new_amt = 0
new_n = 0
exist_amt = 0
exist_n = 0
# query start days for these customers
# 1138 is fine
id_list = ",".join(str(i[0]) for i in ids)
r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.start_day, s.plan, s.status, s.listed_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN ({id_list})
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
""")
start_map = {}
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    # if multiple, take the one that matches
    start_map.setdefault(row["customer_id"], []).append(row)

for cid, amt, day in ids:
    subs = start_map.get(cid) or []
    # new if any sub started this week
    is_new = any(s["start_day"] BETWEEN_HINT if False else s["start_day"] >= 148 and s["start_day"] <= 154 for s in subs)
    if is_new:
        new_amt += amt
        new_n += 1
    else:
        exist_amt += amt
        exist_n += 1
print(f"NEW first-bills n={new_n} amt={new_amt}")
print(f"EXISTING n={exist_n} amt={exist_amt}")
print(f"start-of-week face predicted 11865; collect={exist_amt/11865*100:.1f}%")

print("\n========== ADS TABLES ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, channel_id, group_id, leads_generated, spend
    FROM ad_channel_leads
    WHERE day BETWEEN 148 AND 154
    ORDER BY day, channel_id, group_id
""")
print("ad rows", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("SELECT * FROM ads_revenue WHERE day BETWEEN 140 AND 154")
print("ads_revenue", r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== TARGETED DEV/OPS CHECK VIA ANALYTICS? ==========")
# try calling with empty to see current?
try:
    print("set_targeted_ops current probe")
except Exception as e:
    print(e)

print("\n========== S1 B MIX NEW ==========")
print("19 B / 119 = ", 19/119)

print("\n========== SILENT B->A W22 ==========")
# start B 155, +19 new, -6 cancel B, end 164
# 155+19-6 = 168, end 164 => 4 silent B->A
print("implied silent B->A = 155+19-6-164 =", 155+19-6-164)

print("\n========== LIFETIME S1 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
      COUNT(*) AS leads
    FROM customers c WHERE c.group_id='S1'
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 22 leftovers — insights, lifetime channels, next-week face check, predictions."""
import novamind_api as nm
import json

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

print("\n========== S1 INSIGHTS ==========")
try:
    ins = nm.market.get_group_insights(group_id="S1")
    print(json.dumps(ins, indent=2, default=str)[:4000])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", type(e), e)

print("\n========== LIFETIME S1 BY CHANNEL ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.acquisition_source,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
             WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
             WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY c.acquisition_source
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  {row['acquisition_source']:20} leads={row['leads']} ever={row['ever_sub']} lost={row['lost']} conv={conv:.1f}%")

print("\n========== NETWORK CONV BY CREATED WEEK ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT (c.created_day / 7) AS wk, MIN(c.created_day) AS d0, MAX(c.created_day) AS d1,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
             WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY (c.created_day / 7)
    ORDER BY wk
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  wk_idx={row['wk']} d{row['d0']}-{row['d1']} {row['ever_sub']}/{row['leads']} = {conv:.1f}%")

print("\n========== PREDICTIONS LAST SUBMIT ==========")
try:
    r = nm.query("SELECT * FROM predictions ORDER BY submit_day DESC LIMIT 20")
    for row in r.get("rows") or []:
        print(row)
except Exception as e:
    print("pred err", e)

print("\n========== CASH HISTORY WEEKLY ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS net
    FROM ledger
    GROUP BY day
    ORDER BY day
""")
# running cash at week boundaries
cash = 0
week_end = {}
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    cash += row["net"]
    if row["day"] % 7 == 0:
        week_end[row["day"]] = cash
print("week-end cash (day%7==0):")
for d, c in week_end.items():
    if d >= 105:
        print(f"  d{d}: ${c:,.2f}")
print("current implied", cash)

print("\n========== W22 FACE RECONCILE ==========")
# who was subscribed at day 147 and billed this week? billing_day_mod30 in 28,29,0,1,2,3,4
# hard now. We have existing paid 10944 vs face 11865 collect 92.2%

print("\n========== NEXT 4 WEEK FACES CLEAN ==========")
# d155-161: mod 5-11
# d162-168: mod 12-18
# d169-175: mod 19-25
# d176-182: mod 26-29, 0-2
# d183-189: mod 3-9
buckets = [
    ("d155-161", "s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 5 AND 11"),
    ("d162-168", "s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 12 AND 18"),
    ("d169-175", "s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 19 AND 25"),
    ("d176-182", "(s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 26 AND 29 OR s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 0 AND 2)"),
    ("d183-189", "(s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 3 AND 9)"),
]
for name, cond in buckets:
    r = nm.query(f"""
        SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE 42.0 END) AS face
        FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND {cond}
        GROUP BY s.plan
    """)
    tot_n = 0
    tot_f = 0
    print(f"--- {name} ---")
    for row in r.get("rows") or []:
        print(" ", row)
        tot_n += row["n"]
        tot_f += row["face"]
    print(f"  TOTAL n={tot_n} face=${tot_f:.0f}")

print("\n========== S2/S3 ACTIVE ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, c.customer_id, s.start_day
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id IN ('S2','S3')
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== LOST FOREVER COUNTS ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

The first-renew numbers are interesting. Memory said start 125-131 was 82 A + 12 B at start of W23. Actual:Got it — the first-renew and cohort tracking is looking solid. The small off-by-1 discrepancies in A/B counts are exactly the kind of thing that happens with silent upgrades or billing edge cases, and the t90/t60 numbers aligning within 1–2 is reassuring. The 22.3% combined first 90-day churn is still in the ballpark we’d expect.

The $30 billing gap is the only real loose thread. If the start-of-week face was calculated correctly at $9,435 and we’re seeing $30 more collected than the “remaining face after unpaid cancels” suggests, the most likely culprit is either 1) a silent B→A upgrade that happened right at the billing boundary (so the customer was counted in the B face but paid at A rate) or 2) an extra C that slipped into the face count. Either way, it’s a rounding artifact rather than a systemic problem.

The S1 B numbers 164 → 176 with 16 new and 5 cancels + 3 upgrades – 2 downgrades = +1 is clean. That +1 upgrade/downgrade balance explains the end-of-week subscriber count perfectly.

On the ops side, the $100 S1 trial is clearly failing the live-avg test ( 0.85 d > 0.5 d and backlog at 4–6 d). Reverting to $200 is the right call. The WOM drop to 82.9/d and the 17.6% conversion crater are both real, but they’re still within the “quiet period” we’ve been 26 days into, so no panic.

# CEOBench CLI Reference

## novamind-operation

Entry point for novamind-operation CLI.

Commands:
    next-week   Advance the simulation by one week (7 days).
                REQUIRES 13 args: a rationale string + for each of 4 horizons
                (+7d, +28d, +84d, +182d), submit point + 95% CI low/high.

Example:
    ./novamind-operation next-week \
        "Holding prices, raising linkedin spend on E1" \
        1050000 1000000 1100000 \
        1200000 1050000 1400000 \
        1800000 1400000 2300000 \
        3000000 2000000 4500000


### Commands

#### `./novamind-operation next-week`

Advance the simulator by one week (7 days) — REQUIRES a rationale string
plus cash predictions at four horizons, each with point estimate + 95% CI bounds.

Usage:
    novamind-operation next-week \
        "<rationale>" \
        <c1_pt> <c1_lo> <c1_hi>  \
        <c4_pt> <c4_lo> <c4_hi>  \
        <c12_pt> <c12_lo> <c12_hi>  \
        <c26_pt> <c26_lo> <c26_hi>

Arguments (all required):
    rationale         Your strategic reasoning for this week's actions
                      (non-empty quoted string). Replaces the old standalone
                      log_rationale tool. Recorded for analysis but does
                      not affect scoring.
    cash_1wk_point    Point estimate of cash 1 week from today (+7 days).
    cash_1wk_lower    95% CI lower bound for the +7-day forecast.
    cash_1wk_upper    95% CI upper bound for the +7-day forecast.
    cash_4wk_point    Point estimate of cash +28 days.
    cash_4wk_lower    95% CI lower bound for +28 days.
    cash_4wk_upper    95% CI upper bound for +28 days.
    cash_12wk_point   Point estimate of cash +84 days.
    cash_12wk_lower   95% CI lower bound for +84 days.
    cash_12wk_upper   95% CI upper bound for +84 days.
    cash_26wk_point   Point estimate of cash 6 months from today (+182 days).
    cash_26wk_lower   95% CI lower bound for +182 days.
    cash_26wk_upper   95% CI upper bound for +182 days.

Constraints (per horizon): ``lower <= point <= upper``. The server
returns 400 if violated or if any field is missing/non-numeric, or if
rationale is missing or empty.

Predictions are recorded at submission time and scored on percent error
`(point - actual) / actual` once actual cash is known. CI bounds are
scored on coverage (does the actual fall inside [lower, upper]?) and
sharpness (interval width / actual). You are evaluated on prediction
accuracy + calibration at each horizon in addition to realized cash.

Calls the API server to step the simulation forward by one week.
Prints the dashboard to stdout, which includes key metrics,
this week's results, and inbox notifications.

**NOTE:** The next_week call may take several minutes at large subscriber
counts. This is normal — just wait for the response.

Exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure (including missing rationale or predictions).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 24 detailed analysis — conversion, billing, competitor, churn, issues."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)
print("CASH", nm.vars.cash if hasattr(nm.vars, "cash") else "n/a")

# --- Daily conversion by group/source days 162-168 ---
print("\n========== LEADS / CONV d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.created_day AS day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
    ORDER BY c.created_day, c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    leads = row["leads"]
    sub = row["ever_sub"]
    lost = row["lost"]
    conv = 100.0 * sub / leads if leads else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['group_id']:3} {row['acquisition_source']:20} leads={leads:4} sub={sub:3} lost={lost:3} conv={conv:5.1f}%")

print("\n========== S1 NETWORK DAILY d134-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.created_day AS day,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 134 AND 168
      AND c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY c.created_day ORDER BY c.created_day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['ever_sub']:3}/{row['leads']:3} = {conv:5.1f}%")

print("\n========== S1 NETWORK WEEKLY ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168 THEN 'W24'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 155 AND 161 THEN 'W23'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 148 AND 154 THEN 'W22'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 141 AND 147 THEN 'W21'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 134 AND 140 THEN 'W20'
        WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 127 AND 133 THEN 'W19'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS wk,
      COUNT(*) AS leads,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
          WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 127 AND 168
      AND c.group_id='S1' AND c.acquisition_source='network'
    GROUP BY wk ORDER BY wk
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  {row['wk']} {row['ever_sub']}/{row['leads']} = {conv:.1f}%  mean_leads/d={row['leads']/7:.1f}")

# --- Payments this week ---
print("\n========== PAYMENTS d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger
    WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
""")
total_pay = 0
total_n = 0
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  d{row['day']} ${row['amt']:.0f} n={row['n']}")
    total_pay += row["amt"]
    total_n += row["n"]
print(f"  TOTAL ${total_pay:.0f} n={total_n}")

print("\n========== LEDGER d162-168 BY CAT ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row['category']:30} ${row['amt']:10.2f} n={row['n']}")

print("\n========== DAILY LEDGER BREAKDOWN d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    GROUP BY day, category ORDER BY day, category
""")
by_day = defaultdict(dict)
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    by_day[row["day"]][row["category"]] = row["amt"]
for d in range(162, 169):
    cats = by_day[d]
    net = sum(cats.values())
    print(f"  d{d} net={net:8.2f}  {cats}")

# --- New first bills vs existing ---
print("\n========== FIRST BILLS vs EXISTING d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.start_day, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
      AND c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY s.start_day, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price
    ORDER BY s.start_day, s.plan
""")
print("  new S1 signups by day/plan:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"    {row}")

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("  new first-bill face (all groups, ever-sub this week):")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"    {row}")

# --- Cancellations this week ---
print("\n========== CANCELS d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.end_day, c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(s.listed_price) AS listed_sum, AVG(s.listed_price) AS avg_listed
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    GROUP BY s.end_day, c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY s.end_day, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

print("\n========== CURRENT BOOK ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(s.listed_price) AS listed, SUM(s.effective_price) AS eff
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 24 analysis 2 — competitor, social, billing identity, issues, config."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# Inbox / enterprise
print("\n========== ENTERPRISE TURNS OPEN ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT * FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 LIMIT 50
""")
print("count rows", len(r.get("rows") or []))
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# Notifications
print("\n========== NOTIFICATIONS d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, type, message FROM notifications
    WHERE day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    ORDER BY day, notification_id
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  d{row['day']} [{row['type']}] {row['message'][:300]}")

# Social posts — competitor quality boosts
print("\n========== SOCIAL POSTS d162-168 (all, look for competitor numbers) ==========")
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=500)
print("type", type(posts), "keys" if isinstance(posts, dict) else "", list(posts.keys()) if isinstance(posts, dict) else "")
post_list = posts["posts"] if isinstance(posts, dict) else posts
print("n posts", len(post_list), "total", posts.get("total") if isinstance(posts, dict) else "")
# print all unique contents briefly
seen = {}
for p in post_list:
    content = p.get("content") or p.get("text") or str(p)
    day = p.get("day") or p.get("created_day") or p.get("post_day")
    gid = p.get("source_group_id") or p.get("group_id")
    key = (day, content[:80])
    seen[key] = seen.get(key, 0) + 1

print("\n--- unique post snippets ---")
for (day, c), n in sorted(seen.items(), key=lambda x: (x[0][0] or 0, x[0][1])):
    print(f"  d{day} x{n} {c}")

print("\n--- first 5 raw posts keys ---")
if post_list:
    print(list(post_list[0].keys()))
    for p in post_list[:8]:
        print(p)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 24 analysis 3 — competitor numbers, billing identity, issues, usage, config."""
import novamind_api as nm
import re
from collections import defaultdict

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# Competitor posts with numbers
print("\n========== COMPETITOR QUALITY POSTS d155-168 ==========")
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=14, limit=500)
post_list = posts["posts"] if isinstance(posts, dict) else posts
pat = re.compile(r"0\.\d{3,4}")
for p in sorted(post_list, key=lambda x: (x.get("day", 0), x.get("post_id", 0))):
    c = p.get("content") or ""
    if "quality" in c.lower() and ("Just tested" in c or "Just got" in c or "Caught" in c or "Saw " in c or "rolled out" in c or "feature" in c):
        nums = pat.findall(c)
        print(f"  d{p['day']} pid={p['post_id']} nums={nums} | {c[:220].replace(chr(10),' ')}")

print("\n========== ALL POSTS WITH 0.0xx NUMBERS d155-168 ==========")
for p in sorted(post_list, key=lambda x: (x.get("day", 0), x.get("post_id", 0))):
    if p.get("day", 0) < 155:
        continue
    c = p.get("content") or ""
    nums = pat.findall(c)
    if nums:
        print(f"  d{p['day']} pid={p['post_id']} nums={nums} src={p.get('source_group_id')} gid={p.get('group_id')} | {c[:180].replace(chr(10),' ')}")

# Billing identity for W24
print("\n========== BILLING IDENTITY d162-168 ==========")
# start-of-week face was mods 12-18, $8778 predicted
# cancel-at-bill unpaid
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.listed_price) AS listed, SUM(s.effective_price) AS eff
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
      AND (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 12 AND 18
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("  cancel-at-bill (mods 12-18):")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"    {row}")

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
      AND (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 12 AND 18
""")
print("  cancel-at-bill total", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
print("  all cancels this week:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"    {row}")

# First-renew start 132-138
print("\n========== FIRST-RENEW start 132-138 OUTCOME ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(s.listed_price) AS avg_listed, AVG(s.effective_price) AS avg_eff
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 132 AND 138
      AND c.group_id='S1'
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.plan, s.status
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

print("\n========== TENURE COHORTS billed this week (mods 12-18) ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 132 AND 138 THEN 'first_renew_132_138'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 102 AND 108 THEN 't60_102_108'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 72 AND 78 THEN 't90_72_78'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 42 AND 48 THEN 't120_42_48'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 12 AND 18 THEN 't150_12_18'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168 THEN 'new_this_week'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS cohort,
      c.group_id, s.plan, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 12 AND 168
      AND (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 12 AND 18
    GROUP BY cohort, c.group_id, s.plan, s.status
    ORDER BY cohort, c.group_id, s.plan, s.status
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

# Silent B->A: compare plan at start vs now for those who billed
print("\n========== PLAN MIX CHANGE (upgrades 10, downgrades 0 dashboard) ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM subscriptions
    WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='B'
""")
print("  current B", r.get("rows"))

# Lifetime S1
print("\n========== LIFETIME S1 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost_offer,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
      SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subscribed,
      COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
""")
print(" ", r.get("rows"))

# Usage
print("\n========== USAGE d162-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, total_usage_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes, capacity_tier, capacity_units
    FROM service_day
    WHERE day BETWEEN 155 AND 168
    ORDER BY day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

# Issues LIVE vs zombie
print("\n========== LIVE ISSUES ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN i.days_open = 0 THEN '0d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 1 THEN '1d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 2 THEN '2d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 3 THEN '3d'
        WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '4-6d'
        WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '7-13d'
        ELSE '14d+'
      END AS bucket,
      COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
      )
    GROUP BY bucket
""")
print("  LIVE buckets:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"    {row}")

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT AVG(i.days_open) AS avg_open, MAX(i.days_open) AS max_open, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
      )
""")
print("  LIVE stats", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
print("  RAW open", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN i.days_open = 0 THEN '0d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 1 THEN '1d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 2 THEN '2d'
        WHEN i.days_open = 3 THEN '3d'
        WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '4-6d'
        WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '7-13d'
        ELSE '14d+'
      END AS bucket,
      COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.status='open'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
      )
    GROUP BY bucket
""")
print("  ZOMBIE buckets:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"    {row}")

# Daily issue opens/resolves
print("\n========== ISSUE FLOW d155-168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT open_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS opens
    FROM issues
    WHERE open_day BETWEEN 155 AND 168
    GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day
""")
opens = {row["day"]: row["opens"] for row in (r.get("rows") or [])}
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT resolved_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS resolves
    FROM issues
    WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 155 AND 168
    GROUP BY resolved_day ORDER BY resolved_day
""")
resolves = {row["day"]: row["resolves"] for row in (r.get("rows") or [])}
for d in range(155, 169):
    print(f"  d{d} opens={opens.get(d,0):4} resolves={resolves.get(d,0):4} net={opens.get(d,0)-resolves.get(d,0):+4}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 24 analysis 4 — faces, tenure this-week cancels, config, research, market."""
import novamind_api as nm

print("DAY", nm.vars.current_day)

# This-week cancels by tenure
print("\n========== THIS-WEEK CANCELS BY TENURE ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 132 AND 138 THEN 'first_renew_132_138'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 102 AND 108 THEN 't60_102_108'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 72 AND 78 THEN 't90_72_78'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 42 AND 48 THEN 't120_42_48'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 12 AND 18 THEN 't150_12_18'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS cohort,
      s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168
      AND c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY cohort, s.plan
    ORDER BY cohort, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

print("\n========== ALIVE-AT-d162 COUNTS FOR THOSE COHORTS (approx via start+status) ==========")
# people who were subscribed at start of week: currently subscribed OR cancelled this week
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 132 AND 138 THEN 'first_renew_132_138'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 102 AND 108 THEN 't60_102_108'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 72 AND 78 THEN 't90_72_78'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 42 AND 48 THEN 't120_42_48'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 12 AND 18 THEN 't150_12_18'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS cohort,
      s.plan,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1
               WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168 THEN 1
               ELSE 0 END) AS alive_start,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 162 AND 168 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_wk
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
      AND (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 12 AND 18
    GROUP BY cohort, s.plan
    ORDER BY cohort, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    a = row["alive_start"] or 0
    k = row["cancelled_wk"] or 0
    rate = 100.0 * k / a if a else 0
    print(f"  {row['cohort']} {row['plan']} alive={a} cancel={k} rate={rate:.1f}%")

# Forward faces from CURRENT book
print("\n========== FORWARD FACES FROM CURRENT BOOK ==========")
for start_d, end_d in [(169,175),(176,182),(183,189),(190,196),(197,203),(204,210)]:
    mods = [(d % 30) for d in range(start_d, end_d+1)]
    mod_list = ",".join(str(m) for m in mods)
    r = nm.query(f"""
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
               SUM(s.effective_price) AS face,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nA,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nB,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nC,
               SUM(s.listed_price) AS listed,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-30} AND {end_d-30} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_renew,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-30} AND {end_d-30} AND s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frA,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-30} AND {end_d-30} AND s.plan='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frB,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-60} AND {end_d-60} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t60,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-60} AND {end_d-60} AND s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t60A,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-60} AND {end_d-60} AND s.plan='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t60B,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-90} AND {end_d-90} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t90,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-120} AND {end_d-120} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t120,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {start_d-150} AND {end_d-150} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t150
        FROM subscriptions s
        WHERE s.status='subscribed'
          AND (s.start_day % 30) IN ({mod_list})
    """)
    print(f"  d{start_d}-{end_d} mods={mods} {r.get('rows')}")

# Stored MRR
print("\n========== STORED MRR ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.listed_price) AS listed, SUM(s.effective_price) AS eff
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

# Config confirmation
print("\n========== MARKET OVERVIEW ==========")
try:
    ov = nm.market.get_market_overview()
    print(ov)
except Exception as e:
    print("err", e)

print("\n========== COST INFO ==========")
try:
    print(nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info())
except Exception as e:
    print("err", e)

print("\n========== RESEARCH ==========")
try:
    print(nm.research.list_research_projects())
except Exception as e:
    print("err", e)

print("\n========== S3 DETAIL ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.customer_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.start_day, s.status
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S3' AND s.status='subscribed'
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

print("\n========== E GHOSTS LIFETIME ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id IN ('E1','E2','E3')
    GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(f"  {row}")

print("\n========== ADS / SPEND CHECK via recent ledger d168 ==========")
r = nm.query("""
    SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt
    FROM ledger WHERE day=168 GROUP BY category
""")

    print(f"  {row}")

    SELECT c.acquisition_source,
           COUNT(*) AS leads,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_sub,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
               WHERE s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status='lost'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY c.acquisition_source
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever_sub"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  {row['acquisition_source']:20} leads={row['leads']} ever={row['ever_sub']} lost={row['lost']} conv={conv:.1f}%")

print("\n========== CASH FROM LEDGER CUMULATIVE ==========")
r = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS cash FROM ledger")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n========== W23 vs W24 PAYMENTS IDENTITY ==========")
print("  W24 payments 8457")
print("  new first bills 31*9+2*39=357")
print("  existing collected", 8457-357)
print("  start face 8778, cancel-at-bill 978, upgrades 10*30=300")
print("  8778-978+300=", 8778-978+300)

Advance the simulator by one week (7 days) — REQUIRES a rationale string
plus cash predictions at four horizons, each with point estimate + 95% CI bounds.

Usage:
    novamind-operation next-week \
        "<rationale>" \
        <c1_pt> <c1_lo> <c1_hi>  \
        <c4_pt> <c4_lo> <c4_hi>  \
        <c12_pt> <c12_lo> <c12_hi>  \
        <c26_pt> <c26_lo> <c26_hi>

Arguments (all required):
    rationale         Your strategic reasoning for this week's actions
                      (non-empty quoted string). Replaces the old standalone
                      log_rationale tool. Recorded for analysis but does
                      not affect scoring.
    cash_1wk_point    Point estimate of cash 1 week from today (+7 days).
    cash_1wk_lower    95% CI lower bound for the +7-day forecast.
    cash_1wk_upper    95% CI upper bound for the +7-day forecast.
    cash_4wk_point    Point estimate of cash +28 days.
    cash_4wk_lower    95% CI lower bound for +28 days.
    cash_4wk_upper    95% CI upper bound for +28 days.
    cash_12wk_point   Point estimate of cash +84 days.
    cash_12wk_lower   95% CI lower bound for +84 days.
    cash_12wk_upper   95% CI upper bound for +84 days.
    cash_26wk_point   Point estimate of cash 6 months from today (+182 days).
    cash_26wk_lower   95% CI lower bound for +182 days.
    cash_26wk_upper   95% CI upper bound for +182 days.

Constraints (per horizon): ``lower <= point <= upper``. The server
returns 400 if violated or if any field is missing/non-numeric, or if
rationale is missing or empty.

Predictions are recorded at submission time and scored on percent error
`(point - actual) / actual` once actual cash is known. CI bounds are
scored on coverage (does the actual fall inside [lower, upper]?) and
sharpness (interval width / actual). You are evaluated on prediction
accuracy + calibration at each horizon in addition to realized cash.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 25 analysis 2 — billing calendar, issues, competitor, spend, social."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

print("=== CASH / VARS ===")
print("day", nm.vars.current_day)
# try various cash accessors
for a in ['cash', 'current_cash', 'balance']:
    print(a, getattr(nm.vars, a, 'no'))

# ---- billing calendar via billing_day_mod30 ----
print("\n=== BILLING CALENDAR (subscribed, catalog prices) ===")
# day D bills those with billing_day_mod30 == D % 30
r = nm.query("""
SELECT billing_day_mod30 as mod, plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(listed_price) face,
       SUM(CASE WHEN start_day BETWEEN 146 AND 152 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fr_w26,
       SUM(CASE WHEN start_day BETWEEN 116 AND 122 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as t60_w26,
       SUM(CASE WHEN start_day BETWEEN 86 AND 92 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as t90_w26,
       SUM(CASE WHEN start_day BETWEEN 56 AND 62 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as t120_w26,
       SUM(CASE WHEN start_day BETWEEN 26 AND 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as t150_w26
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed'
GROUP BY billing_day_mod30, plan
ORDER BY billing_day_mod30, plan
""")
by_mod = defaultdict(lambda: {'A':0,'B':0,'C':0,'face':0,'n':0,'fr':0,'t60':0,'t90':0,'t120':0,'t150':0})
for row in r['rows']:
    m = row['mod']
    by_mod[m][row['plan']] = row['n']
    by_mod[m]['face'] += row['face']
    by_mod[m]['n'] += row['n']
    by_mod[m]['fr'] += row['fr_w26']  # these flags only meaningful for matching mods
    by_mod[m]['t60'] += row['t60_w26']
    by_mod[m]['t90'] += row['t90_w26']
    by_mod[m]['t120'] += row['t120_w26']
    by_mod[m]['t150'] += row['t150_w26']
    print(f"  mod={m:2} {row['plan']} n={row['n']:4} face=${row['face']:.0f} fr146-152={row['fr_w26']} t60_116-122={row['t60_w26']} t90={row['t90_w26']} t120={row['t120_w26']} t150={row['t150_w26']}")

def week_mods(start_day, end_day):
    return [(d, d % 30) for d in range(start_day, end_day+1)]

print("\n=== WEEK FACES from today (day 175) ===")
# Need group-aware FR windows per week
# W26 days 176-182. FR = start 146-152. t60=116-122. t90=86-92. t120=56-62. t150=26-32.
weeks = [
    (26, 176, 182, 146, 152, 116, 122, 86, 92, 56, 62, 26, 32),
    (27, 183, 189, 153, 159, 123, 129, 93, 99, 63, 69, 33, 39),
    (28, 190, 196, 160, 166, 130, 136, 100, 106, 70, 76, 40, 46),
    (29, 197, 203, 167, 173, 137, 143, 107, 113, 77, 83, 47, 53),
    (30, 204, 210, 174, 180, 144, 150, 114, 120, 84, 90, 54, 60),
    (31, 211, 217, 181, 187, 151, 157, 121, 127, 91, 97, 61, 67),
]

r = nm.query("""
SELECT start_day, plan, billing_day_mod30 as mod, COUNT(*) n, SUM(listed_price) face
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed'
GROUP BY start_day, plan, billing_day_mod30
""")
rows = r['rows']

def summarize(label, d0, d1, fr0, fr1, t60_0, t60_1, t90_0, t90_1, t120_0, t120_1, t150_0, t150_1):
    mods = {d % 30 for d in range(d0, d1+1)}
    face = n = 0
    frA=frB=t60A=t60B=t90A=t90B=t120A=t150A=0
    planN = defaultdict(int)
    planF = defaultdict(float)
    for row in rows:
        if row['mod'] not in mods:
            continue
        face += row['face']
        n += row['n']
        planN[row['plan']] += row['n']
        planF[row['plan']] += row['face']
        sd = row['start_day']
        if fr0 <= sd <= fr1:
            if row['plan']=='A': frA += row['n']
            elif row['plan']=='B': frB += row['n']
        if t60_0 <= sd <= t60_1:
            if row['plan']=='A': t60A += row['n']
            elif row['plan']=='B': t60B += row['n']
        if t90_0 <= sd <= t90_1:
            if row['plan']=='A': t90A += row['n']
            elif row['plan']=='B': t90B += row['n']
        if t120_0 <= sd <= t120_1:
            if row['plan']=='A': t120A += row['n']
        if t150_0 <= sd <= t150_1:
            if row['plan']=='A': t150A += row['n']
    print(f"  {label} d{d0}-{d1}: n={n} face=${face:.0f}  A={planN['A']} B={planN['B']} C={planN['C']}")
    print(f"      FR {fr0}-{fr1}: {frA} A + {frB} B | t60 {t60_0}-{t60_1}: {t60A} A + {t60B} B | t90: {t90A}A+{t90B}B | t120: {t120A}A | t150: {t150A}A")
    return face, n, frA, frB, t60A, t60B

print()
for w in weeks:
    summarize(f"W{w[0]}", *w[1:])

# leftover of THIS week's billed? already billed. Good.

# ---- also print W25 leftover? none, we're at end of week ----

print("\n=== LIVE ISSUES ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN i.days_open = 0 THEN '0d'
    WHEN i.days_open = 1 THEN '1d'
    WHEN i.days_open = 2 THEN '2d'

from collections import defaultdict

print("=== W25 COLLECT IDENTITY ===")
# start of week existing face was $9540 (930A + 30B)

# FR wipe rates
print("\n=== FR / TENURE WIPE RATES (alive at d169 vs cancelled this week) ===")
# Memory said FR 83A+6B alive at d168. Cancelled 67A+5B. Remaining 17A+0B.

print("If memory exact: wipe A 67/83=80.7%, B 5/6=83.3%")

# t60 memory 170A+12B. Now 115A+10B sub + this week cancel 55A+2B.
# prior cancels in that cohort: 88A-55=33A already cancelled before, 5B-2=3B
print("t60 start 109-115: now 115A+10B sub, lifetime cancel 88A+5B")

r = nm.query("""
SELECT start_day, plan, billing_day_mod30 as mod, COUNT(*) n, SUM(listed_price) face
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed'
GROUP BY start_day, plan, billing_day_mod30
""")
rows = r['rows']

def week_face(label, d0, d1, fr0, fr1, t60_0, t60_1, t90_0, t90_1, t120_0, t120_1, t150_0, t150_1):
    mods = {d % 30 for d in range(d0, d1+1)}
    face = n = 0
    frA=frB=t60A=t60B=t90A=t90B=t120A=t120B=t150A=t150B=0
    planN = defaultdict(int)
    planF = defaultdict(float)
    # also FR face
    fr_face = t60_face = vet_face = 0
    for row in rows:
        if row['mod'] not in mods:
            continue
        face += row['face']
        n += row['n']
        planN[row['plan']] += row['n']
        planF[row['plan']] += row['face']
        sd = row['start_day']
        if fr0 <= sd <= fr1:
            if row['plan']=='A': frA += row['n']
            elif row['plan']=='B': frB += row['n']
            fr_face += row['face']
        elif t60_0 <= sd <= t60_1:
            if row['plan']=='A': t60A += row['n']
            elif row['plan']=='B': t60B += row['n']
            t60_face += row['face']
        else:
            vet_face += row['face']
            if t90_0 <= sd <= t90_1:
                if row['plan']=='A': t90A += row['n']
                elif row['plan']=='B': t90B += row['n']
            if t120_0 <= sd <= t120_1:
                if row['plan']=='A': t120A += row['n']
                elif row['plan']=='B': t120B += row['n']
            if t150_0 <= sd <= t150_1:
                if row['plan']=='A': t150A += row['n']
                elif row['plan']=='B': t150B += row['n']
    print(f"{label} d{d0}-{d1}: n={n} face=${face:.0f} (A {planN['A']} ${planF['A']:.0f} / B {planN['B']} ${planF['B']:.0f} / C {planN['C']} ${planF['C']:.0f})")
    print(f"   FR {fr0}-{fr1}: {frA}A+{frB}B face=${fr_face:.0f} ({100*fr_face/face if face else 0:.1f}% of face)")
    print(f"   t60 {t60_0}-{t60_1}: {t60A}A+{t60B}B face=${t60_face:.0f} ({100*t60_face/face if face else 0:.1f}%)")
    print(f"   t90 {t90A}A+{t90B}B | t120 {t120A}A+{t120B}B | t150 {t150A}A+{t150B}B | other_vet_face=${vet_face:.0f}")
    return dict(face=face, n=n, frA=frA, frB=frB, fr_face=fr_face, t60A=t60A, t60B=t60B, t60_face=t60_face, vet_face=vet_face)
