#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 26 deep analysis — days 176-182."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WEEK 26 ANALYSIS day={DAY} =====")

# ---- 1. Daily conversion by source/group ----
print("\n=== DAILY LEADS/SUBS/LOST days 176-182 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day AS day, c.group_id,
       COALESCE(c.acquisition_source, 'NULL') AS src,
       s.status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id, COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL'), s.status
ORDER BY c.created_day, c.group_id, src, s.status
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n=== WEEKLY CONV by group/src ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL') AS src,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live,
       COUNT(*) AS leads
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY c.group_id, COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL')
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    leads = row["leads"]
    ever = row["ever"]
    conv = 100.0 * ever / leads if leads else 0
    print(f"{row['group_id']:4} {row['src']:20} leads={leads:4} ever={ever:3} lost={row['lost']:4} live={row['live']:3} conv={conv:.2f}%")

print("\n=== DAILY S1 NETWORK CONV ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day AS day,
       COUNT(*) AS leads,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 169 AND 182
  AND c.group_id='S1'
  AND COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL')='network'
GROUP BY c.created_day
ORDER BY c.created_day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    conv = 100.0 * row["ever"] / row["leads"] if row["leads"] else 0
    print(f"  d{row['day']} {row['ever']}/{row['leads']} = {conv:.1f}%  lost={row['lost']}")

# ---- 2. Payments this week ----
print("\n=== PAYMENTS d176-182 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM ledger
WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
""")
print("WEEK PAY:", r.get("rows"))

print("\n=== LEDGER BY CAT d176-182 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- 3. New first bills vs existing ----
print("\n=== NEW SUBS THIS WEEK (created 176-182, now subscribed) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 AND s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- 4. Cancels this week ----
print("\n=== CANCELS end_day 176-182 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(s.listed_price) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
""")
print("total cancels end_day 176-182:", r.get("rows"))

# ---- 5. First-renew / tenure wipe ----
print("\n=== TENURE WIPE by start_day cohort (S1) ===")
# FR: start 146-152 (tenure ~30 at bill d176-182)
# t60: start 116-122
# t90: start 86-92
# t120: start 56-62
# t150: start 26-32
cohorts = [
    ("FR start146-152", 146, 152),
    ("t60 start116-122", 116, 122),
    ("t90 start86-92", 86, 92),
    ("t120 start56-62", 56, 62),
    ("t150 start26-32", 26, 32),
    ("t180 start0-2? wait -4-2", 0, 2),
]
# Also check who was subscribed at start of week (end of day 175) vs now
for name, a, b in cohorts:
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT s.plan, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day BETWEEN {a} AND {b}
      AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.plan, s.status
    """)
    print(f"  {name}:")
    for row in r.get("rows") or []:
        print("   ", row)

# Who cancelled this week by start_day bucket
print("\n=== THIS-WEEK CANCELS by start_day bucket (S1) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 146 AND 152 THEN 'FR 146-152'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 116 AND 122 THEN 't60 116-122'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 86 AND 92 THEN 't90 86-92'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 56 AND 62 THEN 't120 56-62'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 26 AND 32 THEN 't150 26-32'
    ELSE 'other '||CAST(s.start_day AS TEXT)
  END AS bucket,
  s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.listed_price) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY 1, s.plan
ORDER BY 1, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n===== END PART 1 =====")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 26 analysis 3 — competitor, issues, social, quality, ghosts, spend, usage."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WEEK 26 ANALYSIS 3 day={DAY} =====")

# ---- Competitor posts ----
print("\n=== SOCIAL POSTS d169-182 (competitor / quality boost) ===")
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=21, limit=500)
plist = posts.get("posts") if isinstance(posts, dict) else posts
print("total returned:", posts.get("total") if isinstance(posts, dict) else len(plist or []))
# filter by day
comp = []
for p in plist or []:
    d = p.get("day") or p.get("created_day") or p.get("post_day")
    text = (p.get("content") or p.get("text") or p.get("message") or "")
    if d is None:
        continue
    if d < 169:
        continue
    low = text.lower()
    if "quality boost" in low or "just tested" in low or "competitor" in low or "0.0" in low:
        print(f"  d{d} gid={p.get('group_id')} src={p.get('source_group_id')} :: {text[:200]}")
        comp.append(p)

print(f"\ncompetitor-like posts in window: {len(comp)}")

# dump all recent unique days + sample
print("\n=== ALL POST DAYS d169+ sample ===")
by_day = defaultdict(int)
for p in plist or []:
    d = p.get("day") or p.get("created_day")
    if d and d >= 169:
        by_day[d] += 1
print(sorted(by_day.items()))

# print first 3 keys of a post
if plist:
    print("post keys:", list(plist[0].keys()))

# ---- Live vs zombie issues ----
print("\n=== LIVE vs ZOMBIE ISSUES ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
  ) THEN 'live' ELSE 'zombie' END AS kind,
  CASE
    WHEN i.days_open = 0 THEN '0d'
    WHEN i.days_open = 1 THEN '1d'
    WHEN i.days_open = 2 THEN '2d'
    WHEN i.days_open = 3 THEN '3d'
    WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '4-6d'
    WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '7-13d'
    ELSE '14d+'
  END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  AVG(i.days_open) AS avg_open,
  MAX(i.days_open) AS max_open
FROM issues i
WHERE i.status='open'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
  ) THEN 'live' ELSE 'zombie' END AS kind,
  COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(i.days_open) AS avg_open, MAX(i.days_open) AS max_open
FROM issues i
WHERE i.status='open'
GROUP BY 1
""")
print("SUMMARY:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# issue flow this week
print("\n=== ISSUE FLOW d176-182 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN open_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened,
  SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved
FROM issues
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

# live opens this week
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM issues i
WHERE i.open_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed')
""")
print("live still-open that opened this week (subset):", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT i.open_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM issues i
WHERE i.open_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY i.open_day ORDER BY 1
""")
print("opens by day (all):")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
SELECT i.resolved_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM issues i
WHERE i.resolved_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY i.resolved_day ORDER BY 1
""")
print("resolves by day (all):")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- Targeted spend ----
print("\n=== TARGETED SPEND / ADS / PROMO ===")
print("market overview already have")
# try to infer from any config
try:
    print("cost info:", nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info())
except Exception as e:
    print("cost_info err", e)

# ---- Enterprise ghosts ----
print("\n=== ENTERPRISE CUSTOMERS ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sub,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS can
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id LIKE 'E%'
GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day, c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers c
WHERE c.group_id LIKE 'E%' AND c.created_day BETWEEN 169 AND 182
GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id
ORDER BY 1,2
""")
print("E arrivals last 2w:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- S3 usage ----
print("\n=== S3 ACTIVE USAGE ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.customer_id, s.plan, s.effective_price, s.start_day
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S3' AND s.status='subscribed'
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT u.customer_id, u.day, u.usage_units
FROM daily_usage u
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=u.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S3' AND u.day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
ORDER BY u.customer_id, u.day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n===== END PART 3 =====")

"""Week 26 analysis 4 — competitor full scan, spend config, remaining faces, insights."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WEEK 26 ANALYSIS 4 day={DAY} =====")

# Full competitor scan last 40 days
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=40, limit=500)
plist = posts.get("posts") if isinstance(posts, dict) else posts
print("total posts returned:", posts.get("total") if isinstance(posts, dict) else len(plist or []))

print("\n=== COMPETITOR QUALITY BOOSTS d140+ ===")
seen = set()
events = []
for p in plist or []:
    d = p.get("day")
    text = p.get("content") or ""
    if d is None or d < 140:
        continue
    low = text.lower()
    if "quality boost" in low or "quality bump" in low or "just tested" in low:
        # extract number
        import re
        nums = re.findall(r"0\.\d{3,4}", text)
        key = (d, tuple(nums))
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        print(f"  d{d}: nums={nums} :: {text[:160]}")
        if nums:
            events.append((d, float(nums[0])))

print("\nUnique events d140+:", events)
stack = sum(v for d,v in events if d >= 117)
print("sum of listed events (d140+):", sum(v for _,v in events))

# Also dump ALL posts d176-182 (not just competitor)
print("\n=== ALL SOCIAL d176-182 ===")
for p in sorted([x for x in (plist or []) if (x.get("day") or 0) >= 176], key=lambda x: (x.get("day"), x.get("post_id",0))):
    text = (p.get("content") or "")[:180]
    print(f"  d{p.get('day')} gid={p.get('group_id')} src={p.get('source_group_id')} type={p.get('customer_type')} :: {text}")

# Insights
print("\n=== GROUP INSIGHTS S1 ===")
try:
    print(nm.market.get_group_insights(group_id="S1"))
except Exception as e:
    print("err", e)

# Current spend via trying marketing getters if any
print("\n=== MARKETING / ANALYTICS MODULE DIR ===")
import novamind_api.marketing as m
import novamind_api.analytics as a
print("marketing:", [x for x in dir(m) if not x.startswith("_")])
print("analytics:", [x for x in dir(a) if not x.startswith("_")])

# Billing remaining 12 weeks more precisely + 26 weeks sketch
print("\n=== ALL MOD FACES ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 AS mod,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(s.effective_price) AS face,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s1a,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s1b
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30
ORDER BY 1
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# FR remaining by start week
print("\n=== REMAINING PRE-BOMB / POST-BOMB FR COHORTS ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 153 AND 159 THEN 'W27 FR 153-159'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 160 AND 166 THEN 'W28 FR 160-166 bomb3'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 167 AND 173 THEN 'W29 FR 167-173 post'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 174 AND 180 THEN 'W30 FR 174-180 floor'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 181 AND 182 THEN 'W31 FR 181-182'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS bucket,
  s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1'
  AND s.start_day >= 153
GROUP BY 1, s.plan
ORDER BY 1, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# How many new S1 subscribed last 30 days (the remaining FR pipeline)
print("\n=== S1 EVER-SUB BY START WEEK (last 10 weeks) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CAST(s.start_day/7 AS INT) AS w,
  MIN(s.start_day) AS d0, MAX(s.start_day) AS d1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS can,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' AND s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liveA,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='B' AND s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liveB

JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  AND s.start_day >= 112
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# Daily burn components last 7
print("\n=== DAILY COST BREAKDOWN d176-182 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS amt
FROM ledger
WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY day, category
ORDER BY day, category
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:

import novamind_api as nm

print("===== WEEK 26 ANALYSIS 5 =====")

r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS can,
  COUNT(*) AS leads
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1'
""")
print("S1 lifetime:", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL') AS src,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
  COUNT(*) AS leads
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1'
GROUP BY 1
""")
print("S1 by channel:")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    leads=row["leads"]; ever=row["ever"]
    print(f"  {row['src']:20} leads={leads} ever={ever} lost={row['lost']} conv={100*ever/leads:.1f}%")

print("\n=== WIPE RATE CHECK ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 146 AND 152 THEN 'FR'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 116 AND 122 THEN 't60'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 86 AND 92 THEN 't90'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 56 AND 62 THEN 't120'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 26 AND 32 THEN 't150'
    ELSE 'oth'
  END AS b,
  s.plan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS can_w,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS can_all
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  AND (
    s.start_day BETWEEN 146 AND 152 OR
    s.start_day BETWEEN 116 AND 122 OR
    s.start_day BETWEEN 86 AND 92 OR
    s.start_day BETWEEN 56 AND 62 OR
    s.start_day BETWEEN 26 AND 32
  )
GROUP BY 1, s.plan
ORDER BY 1, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    alive = row["live"] + row["can_w"]
    wipe = 100*row["can_w"]/alive if alive else 0
    print(f"  {row['b']} {row['plan']}: live={row['live']} can_week={row['can_w']} alive_at_bill≈{alive} wipe={wipe:.1f}% can_all={row['can_all']}")

print("\n=== W30 tenure mix ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 174 AND 180 THEN 'FR 174-180'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 144 AND 150 THEN 't60 144-150'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 114 AND 120 THEN 't90 114-120'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 84 AND 90 THEN 't120 84-90'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 54 AND 60 THEN 't150 54-60'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 24 AND 30 THEN 't180 24-30'
    ELSE 'other '||CAST(s.start_day AS TEXT)

  s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1'

GROUP BY 1, s.plan
ORDER BY 1, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:

  CASE

    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 151 AND 157 THEN 't60 151-157'

  END AS bucket,
  s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1'
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7)
GROUP BY 1, s.plan
ORDER BY 1, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("cash end d175:", r.get("rows"))
r = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS cash FROM ledger WHERE day <= 182")

for row in r.get("rows") or []:

# network rate

"""Week 27 deep analysis — days 183-189."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WEEK 27 ANALYSIS day={DAY} =====")

# ---- 0. Basics ----

try:

except Exception as e:

except Exception as e:
    print("cost err", e)

r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day AS day, c.group_id,
       COALESCE(c.acquisition_source, 'NULL') AS src,
       s.status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189
GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id, COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL'), s.status
ORDER BY c.created_day, c.group_id, src, s.status
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

print("\n=== WEEKLY CONV by group/src ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL') AS src,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live,
       COUNT(*) AS leads
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189
GROUP BY c.group_id, COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL')
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:

    print(f"{row['group_id']:4} {row['src']:20} leads={leads:4} ever={ever:3} lost={row['lost']:4} live={row['live']:3} conv={conv:.2f}%")

r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day AS day,
       COUNT(*) AS leads,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 169 AND 189
  AND c.group_id='S1'
  AND COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL')='network'
GROUP BY c.created_day
ORDER BY c.created_day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:

# ---- 2. Payments this week ----
print("\n=== PAYMENTS d183-189 ===")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Week 27 analysis 3 — billing identity, next faces, issues, usage, S3, enterprise."""
import novamind_api as nm

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WEEK 27 ANALYSIS3 day={DAY} =====")

# ---- Billing identity ----
# Start-of-week face was $10,743 for d183-189 (n=1040)
# Payments $7,632 from 778 txns
# Cancels: 239 A + 21 B + 1 S3 A + 1 S3 C
# Silent B->A: dashboard downgrades 3
print("\n=== PAYMENTS vs expected ===")
print("start face $10743, pay $7632, collect=", round(7632/10743*100,1), "%")
print("unpaid cancel face ~ 239*9 + 21*39 + 9 + 42 =", 239*9 + 21*39 + 9 + 42)
print("identity: 10743 - unpaid - silent*30 ~= pay")
print("unpaid", 239*9+21*39+9+42, "silent 3*30=90 => leftover", 10743 - (239*9+21*39+9+42) - 90)

# New first bills
print("\n=== NEW FIRST BILLS (created this week, paid this week) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.plan, s.listed_price, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(s.listed_price),2) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189
  AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY s.plan, s.listed_price
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

# S1 B stock identity
print("\n=== S1 B stock identity ===")
print("W26 end: 140 B. W27: 21 B cancel, 3 silent B->A, 0 new => 140-21-3=116. Matches 116.")

# S3 fate
print("\n=== S3 ALL TIME ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.customer_id, s.plan, s.status, s.start_day, s.end_day, s.listed_price
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S3' AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
ORDER BY s.start_day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- Next week billing faces from CURRENT subscribed ----
print("\n=== NEXT BILLING FACES (currently subscribed, catalog price) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 AS mod,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nA,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nB,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nC,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 WHEN s.plan='C' THEN 42.0 ELSE s.listed_price END),2) AS face
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30
ORDER BY s.billing_day_mod30
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# Week buckets: d190-196 = mod 10-16? 
# day 190 mod30 = 10 (190-6*30=10). Wait 30*6=180, 190-180=10.
# d183 mod = 183-180=3. So d183-189 = mod 3-9.
# d190-196 = mod 10-16
# d197-203 = mod 17-23
# d204-210 = mod 24-30/0
# d211-217 = mod 1-7
print("\n=== WEEK FACES FROM NOW ===")
# We'll compute in python from the query
mods = r.get("rows") or []
by_mod = {row["mod"]: row for row in mods}

def week_face(mod_list):
    n=nA=nB=nC=face=0
    for m in mod_list:
        row = by_mod.get(m) or by_mod.get(m % 30)
        if not row:
            # try 0 for 30
            continue
        n += row["n"]; nA += row["nA"]; nB += row["nB"]; nC += row["nC"]; face += row["face"]
    return n, nA, nB, nC, face

# d190-196 mods 10,11,12,13,14,15,16
# d197-203 mods 17-23
# d204-210 mods 24,25,26,27,28,29,0
# d211-217 mods 1-7
# d218-224 mods 8-14
# d225-231 mods 15-21
weeks = [
    ("d190-196 W28", [10,11,12,13,14,15,16]),
    ("d197-203 W29", [17,18,19,20,21,22,23]),
    ("d204-210 W30", [24,25,26,27,28,29,0]),
    ("d211-217 W31", [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]),
    ("d218-224 W32", [8,9,10,11,12,13,14]),
    ("d225-231 W33", [15,16,17,18,19,20,21]),
]
for name, ms in weeks:
    n, nA, nB, nC, face = week_face(ms)
    print(f"{name}: n={n} A={nA} B={nB} C={nC} face=${face:.0f}")

# ---- Tenure buckets for NEXT week (d190-196) ----
# first-renew start 160-166
# t60 start 130-136
# t90 start 100-106
# t120 start 70-76
# t150 start 40-46
# t180 start 10-16
print("\n=== NEXT WEEK TENURE COHORTS (currently subscribed S1) ===")
ranges = [
    ("FR start 160-166", 160, 166),
    ("t60 start 130-136", 130, 136),
    ("t90 start 100-106", 100, 106),
    ("t120 start 70-76", 70, 76),
    ("t150 start 40-46", 40, 46),
    ("t180 start 10-16", 10, 16),
]
for name, a, b in ranges:
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE s.listed_price END),2) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day BETWEEN {a} AND {b}
    GROUP BY s.plan
    """)
    print(name, r.get("rows"))

# Also other groups in next week
print("\n=== NEXT WEEK ALL GROUPS start buckets ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 160 AND 166 THEN 'FR'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 130 AND 136 THEN 't60'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 100 AND 106 THEN 't90'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 70 AND 76 THEN 't120'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 40 AND 46 THEN 't150'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 't180'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS bucket,
  c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 10 AND 16
GROUP BY bucket, c.group_id, s.plan
ORDER BY bucket, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- Usage / service ----
print("\n=== SERVICE d183-189 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, total_usage_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes, capacity_tier, capacity_units
FROM service_day WHERE day BETWEEN 183 AND 189 ORDER BY day
""")
for row in r.get("rows") or []:
    print(row)

# ---- Issues LIVE vs zombie ----
print("\n=== LIVE OPEN ISSUES ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(i.days_open),2) AS avg_open, MAX(i.days_open) AS max_open
FROM issues i
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE i.status='open'
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d0,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d3,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d4_6,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d7_13,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open>=14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d14p
FROM issues i
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE i.status='open'
""")
print("live buckets", r.get("rows"))

print("\n=== ALL OPEN ISSUES (incl zombies) ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n=== ISSUE FLOW d183-189 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN open_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opens,
  SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolves
FROM issues
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.open_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live_opens,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.resolved_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live_resolves
FROM issues i
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
""")
print("live-customer flow (includes tickets of people still subscribed)", r.get("rows"))

# ---- Enterprise ----
print("\n=== ENTERPRISE TURNS OPEN ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print(r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers c
WHERE c.group_id IN ('E1','E2','E3')
GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
print("E customers ever", r.get("rows"))

r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day, c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers c
WHERE c.group_id IN ('E1','E2','E3') AND c.created_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189
GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id
""")
print("E this week", r.get("rows"))

# ---- Ads check ----
print("\n=== AD SPEND this week ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(spend) AS spend, SUM(leads_generated) AS leads
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 183 AND 189
GROUP BY channel_id, group_id
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

import novamind_api as nm

print("===== WEEK 27 ANALYSIS5 =====")

defs = [
    ("W28", 190, 196),

    ("W30", 204, 210),
    ("W31", 211, 217),
    ("W32", 218, 224),
    ("W33", 225, 231),
]

print("\n=== TENURE BY UPCOMING BILL WEEK (S1 subscribed) ===")
for name, d0, d1 in defs:
    mods = [(d % 30) for d in range(d0, d1+1)]
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {d0-30} AND {d1-30} THEN 'FR'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {d0-60} AND {d1-60} THEN 't60'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {d0-90} AND {d1-90} THEN 't90'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {d0-120} AND {d1-120} THEN 't120'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {d0-150} AND {d1-150} THEN 't150'
        WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN {d0-180} AND {d1-180} THEN 't180'
        ELSE 'vet+'
      END AS bucket,
      s.plan,
      COUNT(*) AS n,
      ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 WHEN s.plan='C' THEN 42.0 ELSE s.listed_price END),2) AS face
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1'
      AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({','.join(str(m) for m in mods)})
    GROUP BY bucket, s.plan
    ORDER BY bucket, s.plan
    """)
    print(f"\n{name} d{d0}-{d1} mods={mods}")
    total_face = 0
    for row in r.get("rows") or []:
        print(" ", row)

FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='B'
GROUP BY bucket
""")
print(r.get("rows"))

print("\n=== STORED MRR ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 WHEN s.plan='C' THEN 42.0 ELSE s.listed_price END),2) AS mrr,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='subscribed'

for row in r.get("rows") or []:

# Non-S1 in upcoming weeks

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30, c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, COUNT(*) AS n

JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Forecast inputs: remaining book, targeted spend, predictions, lifetime, cost."""
import novamind_api as nm

print("===== WEEK 28 ANALYSIS 5 =====")

print("\n=== CASH / LEDGER TOTAL ===")
print(nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) cash FROM ledger"))

print("\n=== LAST WEEK PREDICTIONS ===")
preds = nm.query("""
    SELECT submit_day, horizon_days, metric, predicted_value, predicted_lower, predicted_upper
    FROM predictions ORDER BY submit_day DESC, horizon_days LIMIT 20
""")
for r in preds.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== targeted ops / dev via analytics or config ===")
cfg = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, tool_name, setting_type, settings_json
    FROM config_overrides
    WHERE setting_type LIKE '%ops%' OR setting_type LIKE '%dev%' OR tool_name LIKE '%ops%' OR tool_name LIKE '%dev%'
    ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 15
""")
for r in cfg.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== get_cost_info ===")
print(nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info())

print("\n=== Lifetime S1 ===")
s1 = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.status, COUNT(*) n
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY s.status
""")
for r in s1.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== S1 ever-real-sub vs leads ===")
s1e = nm.query("""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ever,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost,
      COUNT(*) leads
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
""")
print(s1e.get("rows"))

print("\n=== S1 by acquisition_source lifetime ===")
src = nm.query("""
    SELECT COALESCE(c.acquisition_source,'NULL') src,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ever,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost,
      COUNT(*) leads
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='S1'
    GROUP BY src
""")
for r in src.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== Currently subscribed start_day histogram (S1) post-160 ===")
post = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.start_day, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day>=160
    GROUP BY s.start_day, s.plan ORDER BY s.start_day
""")
for r in post.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== FULL billing calendar remaining book ===")
cal = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 m, s.plan, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39 ELSE 42 END) face
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
    GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30, s.plan, c.group_id
    ORDER BY s.billing_day_mod30
""")
from collections import defaultdict
by_m = defaultdict(lambda: {"n":0,"face":0.0,"A":0,"B":0,"C":0})
for r in cal.get("rows") or []:
    by_m[r["m"]]["n"] += r["n"]
    by_m[r["m"]]["face"] += r["face"]
    by_m[r["m"]][r["plan"]] += r["n"]

# weeks from day 197
# 197%30 = 17
weeks = [
    ("W29 d197-203", list(range(17,24))),
    ("W30 d204-210", [24,25,26,27,28,29,0]),
    ("W31 d211-217", list(range(1,8))),
    ("W32 d218-224", list(range(8,15))),
    ("W33 d225-231", list(range(15,22))),
    ("W34 d232-238", list(range(22,29))),
    ("W35 d239-245", [29,0,1,2,3,4,5]),
]
for name, mods in weeks:
    n=face=A=B=C=0
    for m in mods:
        n += by_m[m]["n"]; face += by_m[m]["face"]
        A += by_m[m]["A"]; B += by_m[m]["B"]; C += by_m[m]["C"]
    print(f"{name}: n={n} face=${face:.0f} A={A} B={B} C={C} mods={mods}")

print("\n=== W29 face check listed vs catalog ===")
w29 = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.listed_price, s.effective_price, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (17,18,19,20,21,22,23)
    GROUP BY s.listed_price, s.effective_price, s.plan
""")
for r in w29.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== Off-bucket cancels W28? (end_day not matching billing) ===")
# billing day for a cancel: if they cancel at bill, end_day % 30 == billing_day_mod30?
off = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.end_day, s.billing_day_mod30, s.end_day % 30 AS end_mod, COUNT(*) n
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 190 AND 196
    GROUP BY s.end_day, s.billing_day_mod30
    ORDER BY s.end_day
""")
for r in off.get("rows") or []:
    match = "BILL" if r["end_mod"]==r["billing_day_mod30"] else "OFF"
    print(match, r)

print("\n=== S1 B start-of-week vs now (silent) ===")
print("start W28 S1 B was 116; now 89; cancels 20; implied silent", 116-20-89)

print("\n=== inbox / enterprise API ===")
print("turns closed check", nm.query("SELECT * FROM enterprise_turns LIMIT 3"))

print("\n=== notifications d182-196 ===")
n = nm.query("SELECT day, type, substr(message,1,200) m FROM notifications WHERE day>=182")
for r in n.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== daily usage last 7 sum ===")
u = nm.query("""
    SELECT day, total_usage_units, downtime_minutes, error_rate, p95_ms
    FROM service_day WHERE day BETWEEN 190 AND 196 ORDER BY day
""")
for r in u.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

print("\n=== research_projects table ===")
rp = nm.query("SELECT * FROM research_projects")
for r in rp.get("rows") or []:
    print(r)

import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

# ========== BILLING FACES NEXT WEEKS ==========
# W31: d211-217 mods 1-7
# W32: d218-224 mods 8-14
# W33: d225-231 mods 15-21
# W34: d232-238 mods 22-28
# W35: d239-245 mods 29,0,1-5  -- overlaps W31

def week_mods(start_day):
    return [d % 30 for d in range(start_day, start_day + 7)]

weeks = {
    "W31": (211, week_mods(211)),
    "W32": (218, week_mods(218)),
    "W33": (225, week_mods(225)),
    "W34": (232, week_mods(232)),
    "W35": (239, week_mods(239)),
}

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 as mod, s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan,
       COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.listed_price) face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30, s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
rows = r["rows"]

def tenure_band(start_day, bill_week_start):
    # tenure at billing ≈ bill_week_start - start_day (approx mid-week +3)
    age = bill_week_start - start_day
    if 28 <= age <= 36:
        return "FR"
    if 58 <= age <= 66:
        return "t60"
    if 88 <= age <= 96:
        return "t90"
    if 118 <= age <= 126:
        return "t120"
    if 148 <= age <= 156:
        return "t150"
    if 178 <= age <= 186:
        return "t180"
    if 208 <= age <= 216:
        return "t210"
    if 238 <= age <= 246:
        return "t240"
    return f"age{age}"

print("=== NEXT WEEK FACES BY TENURE ===")
for wname, (wstart, mods) in weeks.items():
    bands = defaultdict(lambda: {"n": 0, "face": 0.0, "A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0, "detail": []})
    total_n = 0
    total_face = 0.0
    for row in rows:
        if row["mod"] not in mods:
            continue
        b = tenure_band(row["start_day"], wstart)
        bands[b]["n"] += row["n"]
        bands[b]["face"] += row["face"]
        bands[b][row["plan"]] = bands[b].get(row["plan"], 0) + row["n"]
        bands[b]["detail"].append(row)
        total_n += row["n"]
        total_face += row["face"]
    print(f"\n{wname} d{wstart}-{wstart+6} mods={mods} n={total_n} face=${total_face:.0f}")
    for b in sorted(bands.keys()):
        d = bands[b]
        print(f"  {b:8s} n={d['n']:4d} face=${d['face']:7.0f}  A={d.get('A',0)} B={d.get('B',0)} C={d.get('C',0)}")

# ========== START-OF-W30 FACE RECONSTRUCTION ==========
# Memory said W30 face $7848. Actual payments $5760. Cancels 184A+8B face 1656+312=1968
# Silent B->A: dashboard downgrades 4. 5760 + 1968 + 4*30 = 5760+1968+120 = 7848. YES.
print("\n=== W30 COLLECT IDENTITY ===")
print("payments 5760 + cancel face 1968 + silent 4*30=120 =", 5760+1968+120)
print("collect vs 7848 =", 5760/7848)

# ========== TENURE WIPE RATES W30 ==========
# Reconstruct start-of-week counts = survivors + cancels + account for silent B->A
# From memory W30 start:
# FR start 174-180: 1A + 1B face $48
# t60 start 144-150: 19A + 1B face $210
# t90 start 114-120: 99A + 8B face $1203
# t120 start 84-90: 124A + 4B face $1272
# t150 start 54-60: 394A + 7B face $3819 (+ S2 2A + S3 C)
# t180 start 24-30: 133A + 1B face $1236
print("\n=== W30 WIPE vs MEMORY START ===")
print("FR: 1A+1B cancelled of 1A+1B = 100%")
print("t60: 19A+1B cancelled of 19A+1B = 100%")
print("t90: 69A+5B cancelled; survivors 31A+2B; start 99A+8B")
print("  A wipe 69/99=69.7%, B 5/8=62.5% (3 silent B->A would explain 99-69-31= -1 wait)")
print("  99A start; 69 cancel A; 31 survive A = 100. Extra +1 A from silent?")
print("  8B start; 5 cancel B; 2 survive B = 7. 1 silent B->A. Yes 8=5+2+1")
print("t120: 62A+1B cancel; survivors 63A+2B; start 124A+4B")
print("  124A + ?silent; 62 cancel A + 63 survive A = 125. +1 silent")
print("  4B: 1 cancel + 2 survive = 3. +1 silent. Yes")
print("t150: 20A cancel; survivors 376A+5B +S2 2A +S3 C; start 394A+7B")
print("  394A: 20 cancel + 376 survive = 396. +2 silent B->A")
print("  7B: 0 cancel + 5 survive = 5. +2 silent. Yes")
print("  A wipe 20/394 = 5.1%")
print("t180: 13A cancel; survivors 120A+1B; start 133A+1B")
print("  133A: 13 cancel + 120 survive = 133. 0 silent")
print("  wipe 13/133 = 9.8%")

# ========== CURRENT BOOK ==========
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.listed_price) mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
print("\nCURRENT BOOK", r["rows"])
r = nm.query("SELECT SUM(listed_price) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'")
print("MRR", r["rows"])

# ========== S3 / S2 still there ==========
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.customer_id, c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.start_day
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id IN ('S2','S3')
""")
print("S2/S3", r["rows"])

# ========== B book collapse ==========
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='B'
""")
print("S1 B now", r["rows"])

# ========== RESEARCH ==========
print("\n=== RESEARCH ===")
print(nm.research.list_research_projects())

# ========== ADS / SPEND STATE ==========
print("\n=== INSIGHTS S1 snippet ===")
ins = nm.market.get_group_insights(group_id="S1")
if isinstance(ins, dict):
    print(list(ins.keys())[:30])
    for k in ins:
        if k in ("info_level", "ads_effectiveness", "conversion", "quality", "expected_quality"):
            print(k, ins[k])
else:
    print(type(ins), str(ins)[:500])

import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 as mod, s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan,
       COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.listed_price) face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30, s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
rows = r["rows"]

def band_for(start_day, wstart):
    age = wstart - start_day  # age at week start; billing happens +0..6
    # Windows cover the 7 billing days
    if 24 <= age <= 36:
        return "FR"
    if 54 <= age <= 66:
        return "t60"
    if 84 <= age <= 96:
        return "t90"
    if 114 <= age <= 126:
        return "t120"
    if 144 <= age <= 156:
        return "t150"
    if 174 <= age <= 186:
        return "t180"
    if 204 <= age <= 216:
        return "t210"
    if 234 <= age <= 246:
        return "t240"
    return f"other{age}"

weeks = {
    "W31": 211,
    "W32": 218,
    "W33": 225,
    "W34": 232,
}

for wname, wstart in weeks.items():
    mods = [d % 30 for d in range(wstart, wstart + 7)]
    bands = defaultdict(lambda: {"n": 0, "face": 0.0, "A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0, "S2": 0, "S3": 0})
    total_n = total_face = 0
    for row in rows:
        if row["mod"] not in mods:
            continue
        b = band_for(row["start_day"], wstart)
        bands[b]["n"] += row["n"]
        bands[b]["face"] += row["face"]
        bands[b][row["plan"]] = bands[b].get(row["plan"], 0) + row["n"]
        if row["group_id"] != "S1":
            bands[b][row["group_id"]] = bands[b].get(row["group_id"], 0) + row["n"]
        total_n += row["n"]
        total_face += row["face"]
    print(f"\n==== {wname} d{wstart}-{wstart+6} mods={mods} n={total_n} face=${total_face:.0f}")
    for b in ["FR", "t60", "t90", "t120", "t150", "t180", "t210", "t240"] + [k for k in sorted(bands) if k.startswith("other")]:
        if b not in bands:
            continue
        d = bands[b]
        extra = ""
        if d.get("S2") or d.get("S3"):
            extra = f" S2={d.get('S2',0)} S3={d.get('S3',0)}"
        print(f"  {b:8s} n={d['n']:4d} face=${d['face']:7.0f}  A={d.get('A',0):4d} B={d.get('B',0):3d} C={d.get('C',0)}{extra}")

# W31 B customers who might silent-downgrade
print("\n==== W31 B customers ====")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='B'
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7)
GROUP BY s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price
ORDER BY s.start_day
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

# S3 usage this week
print("\n==== S3/S2 usage ====")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT u.day, u.customer_id, u.usage_units
FROM daily_usage u
WHERE u.customer_id IN (2169,2170,2172,2242,2513,3095)
  AND u.day BETWEEN 204 AND 210
ORDER BY u.customer_id, u.day
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

# Notifications
print("\n==== NOTIFICATIONS d204-210 ====")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, type, message FROM notifications WHERE day BETWEEN 204 AND 210 ORDER BY day")
print("count", r["row_count"])
for row in r["rows"][:40]:
    print(row)

# Ads spend confirmation
print("\n==== ADS SPEND W30 ====")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, channel_id, group_id, leads_generated, spend FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 204 AND 210")
print(r["rows"][:20], "n=", r["row_count"])

# Targeted spend / current marketing state via a small probe
print("\n==== CURRENT SPEND / PROMO / ADS via trying get? ====")
# check analytics targeted
try:
    print("ops targeted call with empty?")
except Exception as e:
    print(e)

import novamind_api as nm

print("=" * 70)
print("W34 TENURE WIPE — billed this week (billing_day_mod30 22-28)")
print("Customers subscribed at start OR cancelled this week, who billed W34")
print("=" * 70)

r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 22 AND 28 THEN 't210 s22-28'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 52 AND 58 THEN 't180 s52-58'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 82 AND 88 THEN 't150 s82-88'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 112 AND 118 THEN 't120 s112-118'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 142 AND 148 THEN 't90 s142-148'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 172 AND 178 THEN 't60 s172-178'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 202 AND 208 THEN 'FR s202-208'
    ELSE 'other_s' || CAST(s.start_day AS TEXT)
  END as band,
  s.plan,
  COUNT(*) as start_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as canc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as still,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE s.listed_price END) as face,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238
           THEN CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE s.listed_price END
           ELSE 0 END) as cancel_face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1'
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 22 AND 28
  AND s.start_day <= 231
  AND (
    s.status='subscribed'
    OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238)
  )
GROUP BY band, s.plan
ORDER BY band, s.plan
""")
tot_n = tot_c = tot_f = tot_cf = 0
for row in r["rows"]:
    n = row["start_n"]
    canc = row["canc"]
    rate = 100.0 * canc / n if n else 0
    tot_n += n
    tot_c += canc
    tot_f += row["face"]
    tot_cf += row["cancel_face"]
    print(f"{row['band']:20} {row['plan']}: n={n:4} canc={canc:4} still={row['still']:4} rate={rate:5.1f}% face={row['face']:7.0f} cf={row['cancel_face']:7.0f}")
print(f"TOTAL n={tot_n} canc={tot_c} rate={100*tot_c/tot_n:.1f}% face={tot_f} cf={tot_cf} collect_if_no_silent={(tot_f-tot_cf)/tot_f*100:.1f}%")

print("\n=" * 35)
print("START_DAY BUCKETS (grouped by 30-day waves) for W34 billed S1")
print("=" * 70)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CAST((s.start_day / 30) AS INT) as wave,
  MIN(s.start_day) as min_s,
  MAX(s.start_day) as max_s,
  s.plan,
  COUNT(*) as n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as canc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE s.listed_price END) as face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1'
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 22 AND 28
  AND s.start_day <= 231
  AND (
    s.status='subscribed'
    OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238)
  )
GROUP BY wave, s.plan
ORDER BY wave, s.plan
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    rate = 100.0 * row["canc"] / row["n"] if row["n"] else 0
    tenure_approx = 231 - (row["min_s"] + row["max_s"]) / 2
    print(f"wave {row['wave']:2} s{row['min_s']}-{row['max_s']} ~t{tenure_approx:.0f} {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:4} canc={row['canc']:4} rate={rate:5.1f}% face={row['face']:.0f}")

print("\n=" * 35)
print("OFF-BUCKET CANCELS (end_day != their billing day this week)")
print("=" * 70)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(*) as n, SUM(listed_price) as face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238
  AND NOT (s.billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 22 AND 28)
""")
print("off-bucket", r["rows"])

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.end_day, s.billing_day_mod30, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 232 AND 238
GROUP BY s.end_day, s.billing_day_mod30
ORDER BY s.end_day, s.billing_day_mod30

import novamind_api as nm

print("day", nm.vars.current_day)

# enterprise
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print("open threads", r["rows"])
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c
WHERE c.group_id LIKE 'E%' OR c.group_id LIKE 'D_%'
GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
print("E/D customers", r["rows"])

r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ever
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id LIKE 'E%'
GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
print("E lifetime", r["rows"])

# remaining book MRR / next 5 weeks faces
print("\nFACES by week from day 239")
for label, mods in [
    ("W35 d239-245", (29,0,1,2,3,4,5)),
    ("W36 d246-252", (6,7,8,9,10,11,12)),
    ("W37 d253-259", (13,14,15,16,17,18,19)),
    ("W38 d260-266", (20,21,22,23,24,25,26)),
    ("W39 d267-273", (27,28,29,0,1,2,3)),
]:
    ph = ",".join(str(m) for m in mods)
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN plan='B' THEN 39.0 WHEN plan='C' THEN 42.0 ELSE listed_price END) face
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({ph})
    """)
    print(label, r["rows"])

# W34 payments vs start face identity
print("\nW34 collect identity")
print("payments 1947, cancel face 3492, still+cancel=5439")

# lifetime S1 cancels
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.status='cancelled'
""")
print("lifetime S1 cancels", r["rows"])

# confirm no ad spend this week
r = nm.query("""
SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt FROM ledger
WHERE day BETWEEN 232 AND 238 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
""")
print("W34 cats")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

# Re-assert config
print("\n=== REASSERT CONFIG ===")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=9, B=39, C=42))
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=2))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=300, B=300, C=1500))
print(nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0))
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=500, development=0))
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={}))
print(nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0))
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0))
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=2))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 200.0}))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 0.0}))
print("config done")

import novamind_api as nm

print("W36 exact bands")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN 't234'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 36 AND 42 THEN 't204-210'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 66 AND 72 THEN 't174-180'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 96 AND 102 THEN 't144-150'
    ELSE 'o' || CAST(s.start_day AS TEXT)
  END as band,
  s.plan, COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE listed_price END) face
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 6 AND 12
GROUP BY band, plan ORDER BY band, plan
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

print("\nW37 exact bands")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 13 AND 19 THEN 't234'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 43 AND 49 THEN 't204-210'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 73 AND 79 THEN 't174-180'
    WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 103 AND 109 THEN 't144-150'
    ELSE 'o' || CAST(s.start_day AS TEXT)
  END as band,
  s.plan, COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE listed_price END) face
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 13 AND 19
GROUP BY band, plan ORDER BY band, plan
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

print("\nW38 d260-266 mod 20-26 bands")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN billing_day_mod30 IN (20,21) THEN 'FIRST_hash4'
    ELSE 'SECOND_bill_W34surv'
  END as kind,
  CAST((start_day/30) AS INT) wave,
  plan, COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN plan='A' THEN 9.0 WHEN plan='B' THEN 39.0 ELSE listed_price END) face
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 BETWEEN 20 AND 26
GROUP BY kind, wave, plan ORDER BY kind, wave, plan
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

print("\nE customers created this week")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT created_day, group_id, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers
WHERE group_id LIKE 'E%' AND created_day BETWEEN 225 AND 238
GROUP BY created_day, group_id
""")
for row in r["rows"]:
    print(row)

print("\nglobal quality check")
print("S1 A delivered 0.5230 => (0.20+g+0.3206)*0.75=0.5230 => g", 0.5230/0.75 - 0.5206)

print("\nW34 S1 B start vs end")
print("start 40, cancel 6, upgrades +2, silent 0 => 36")

print("\navg usage remaining")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT AVG(u.usage_units) avg_u, COUNT(*) n
FROM daily_usage u
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=u.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE u.day=238
""")
print(r["rows"])

# Reconstruct who was subscribed at start of W35 (end of day 238):
# status=subscribed now OR (cancelled with end_day 239-245)
# PLUS they had a subscription active on day 238.

print("=== W35 START BOOK by start_day (billing this week = billing_day_mod30 in 239-245 mod 30) ===")
# 239%30=29, 240%30=0, 241%30=1, 242%30=2, 243%30=3, 244%30=4, 245%30=5
# so mods 29,0,1,2,3,4,5

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.start_day, s.billing_day_mod30, c.group_id, s.plan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as still,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as canc,
  COUNT(*) as n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.listed_price
           WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245 THEN s.listed_price
           ELSE 0 END) as face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  AND s.start_day <= 238
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day >= 239))
GROUP BY s.start_day, s.billing_day_mod30, c.group_id, s.plan
ORDER BY s.start_day, c.group_id, s.plan
""")

    ELSE 'other_s' || s.start_day

  c.group_id, s.plan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1
           WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245 THEN 1

GROUP BY 1, c.group_id, s.plan
ORDER BY 1, c.group_id, s.plan
""")

import novamind_api as nm

# Reconstruct W35 start-of-week face for billed mods 29,0,1,2,3,4,5
# start book = currently subscribed with those mods + cancelled this week with those mods

print("=== W35 billed start face reconstruct ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (29,0,1,2,3,4,5) THEN s.listed_price ELSE 0 END) as still_face,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245 AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (29,0,1,2,3,4,5) THEN s.listed_price ELSE 0 END) as cancel_face,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (29,0,1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as still_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245 AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (29,0,1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancel_n
FROM subscriptions s
""")
print(r['rows'])
# still_face after upgrades: people who upgraded A→B now have listed 39
# start face = still_face + cancel_face - 30*upgrades  (because those 4 now sit in still as $39 instead of $9)
# payments 2646
# 4 upgrades billed $39 so they are in still_face as 39

print("\n=== W36 face current subscribed mods 6-12 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(listed_price) as face, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (6,7,8,9,10,11,12)
""")
print(r['rows'])

print("=== W37 mods 13-19 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(listed_price) as face, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (13,14,15,16,17,18,19)
""")
print(r['rows'])

print("=== W38 mods 20-26 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(listed_price) as face, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (20,21,22,23,24,25,26)
""")
print(r['rows'])

print("=== W39 mods 27-3 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(listed_price) as face, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (27,28,29,0,1,2,3)
""")
print(r['rows'])

# W36 tenure mix of CURRENT remaining book
print("\n=== W36 tenure mix (current remaining = first-bill-after-#4 for these people) ===")
# start 36-42: tenure at bill ~ (246-252)-36/42 = 210-216 → t210
# start 66-72: tenure ~ 180-186 → t180  FIRST BILL AFTER #4
# start 6-12: tenure ~ 240 → t240
# start 96-102: tenure ~ 150 → t150 leftovers

r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 15 THEN 't240'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 36 AND 42 THEN 't210'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 66 AND 72 THEN 't180'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 96 AND 102 THEN 't150'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as band,
  plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(listed_price) as face
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (6,7,8,9,10,11,12)
GROUP BY 1, plan
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row)

print("\n=== W37 tenure mix ===")
# start 15-19 t240; 43-49 t210; 73-79 t180; 103-109 t150
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28 THEN 't240'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 43 AND 49 THEN 't210'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 73 AND 79 THEN 't180'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 103 AND 109 THEN 't150'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as band,
  plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(listed_price) as face
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (13,14,15,16,17,18,19)
GROUP BY 1, plan
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row)

print("\n=== W38 tenure mix ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28 THEN 't240'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 50 AND 56 THEN 't210'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 80 AND 86 THEN 't165'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 110 AND 118 THEN 't150'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as band,
  plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(listed_price) as face
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (20,21,22,23,24,25,26)
GROUP BY 1, plan
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row)

print("\n=== last week predicted W36 face was 5517 — now remaining after W34 wipe? ===")
# last week's W36 face was from day 238 book. W35 cancelled some of those? No, different mods.
# W36 people did NOT bill in W35. Their face is unchanged except plan changes this week among them.
print("current W36 face from query above")

# W35 collect vs start
# last week predicted face 6381. Let's verify with reconstruct
print("\n=== W35 t180/t210 wipe detail (billed only) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 't240'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 29 AND 35 THEN 't210'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 59 AND 65 THEN 't180'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 89 AND 95 THEN 't150'
    WHEN start_day BETWEEN 119 AND 125 THEN 't120'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as band,
  c.group_id, s.plan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as start_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as canc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 239 AND 245)) THEN s.listed_price ELSE 0 END) as face
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.billing_day_mod30 IN (29,0,1,2,3,4,5)
  AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  AND s.start_day <= 238
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR s.end_day >= 239)
GROUP BY 1, c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    wipe = row['canc']/row['start_n']*100 if row['start_n'] else 0
    print(f"{row['band']} {row['group_id']} {row['plan']}: n={row['start_n']} canc={row['canc']} wipe={wipe:.1f}% face={row['face']}")

print("\n=== usage remaining weekdays ===")
print("W35 usage 187,188,174,154,90,87,141k. Peak 188k = 23.5% of 800k. Weekdays now <190k.")
print("Tier 1 cap is 200k. Peak 188k is TOO CLOSE. Do NOT drop.")

print("\n=== compute this week ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, amount FROM ledger WHERE category='compute' AND day BETWEEN 239 AND 245")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row)

# t150: start 80-109
# t120: start 110-139

"""W38 billing wipe + next-week faces."""
import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

print("=" * 70)
print("PAYMENTS W38 (d260-266)")
print("=" * 70)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) as amt, COUNT(*) as n
FROM ledger
WHERE day BETWEEN 260 AND 266 AND amount > 0
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
""")
print("positive:", r["rows"])

r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) as amt, COUNT(*) as n
FROM ledger
WHERE day BETWEEN 260 AND 266 AND category LIKE '%sub%' OR (day BETWEEN 260 AND 266 AND amount > 0)
GROUP BY 1
""")
print("try2", r)

# list categories
r = nm.query("SELECT DISTINCT category FROM ledger")

""")

    "W40 d274-280": range(274, 281),

    print('  ', content[:220].replace(chr(10),' '))
    print()

import novamind_api as nm

print('=== ISSUES ===')
r = nm.query(\"\"\"
SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open'
\"\"\")
print('open total', r['rows'])

r = nm.query(\"\"\"
SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues i
WHERE i.status='open'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id=i.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed')
\"\"\")
print('open live', r['rows'])

print('=== USAGE ===')
r = nm.query(\"\"\"
SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) as u FROM daily_usage
WHERE day >= 330 AND day <= 336
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
\"\"\")
print(r['rows'])

print('=== RESEARCH ===')
print(nm.research.list_research_projects())

print('=== COST INFO ===')
print(nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info())

print('=== S1 LIFETIME CONV ===')
r = nm.query(\"\"\"
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ever_sub,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelled,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as live,
  COUNT(*) as rows
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1'
\"\"\")
print(r['rows'])

print('=== S1 LEADS BY SOURCE ===')
r = nm.query(\"\"\"
SELECT c.acquisition_source,
  COUNT(*) as leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ever_sub,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lost
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND c.customer_id != 1
GROUP BY c.acquisition_source
\"\"\")
print(r['rows'])

print('=== LAST LEAD / CANCEL / PAY ===')
r = nm.query('SELECT MAX(created_day) as last_lead FROM customers WHERE customer_id != 1')
print('last lead', r['rows'])
r = nm.query(\"\"\"SELECT MAX(end_day) as last_cancel FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'\"\"\")
print('last cancel', r['rows'])
r = nm.query(\"\"\"SELECT MAX(day) as last_pay FROM ledger WHERE amount > 0\"\"\")
print('last pay', r['rows'])
"

print("=== CONV d407-413 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.created_day >= 407
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
print("new this week", r)

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.created_day, c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.created_day >= 400
GROUP BY s.created_day, c.group_id, s.status
ORDER BY s.created_day
""")

SELECT MAX(s.created_day) last_created, MAX(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.created_day END) last_sub,

r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amt, COUNT(*) n
FROM ledger
WHERE day >= 407 AND amount > 0
GROUP BY day, category
""")

r = nm.query("""
SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amt
FROM ledger
WHERE day >= 407
GROUP BY category
""")
print("week cats", r)

print("\n=== USAGE / SERVICE ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT * FROM service_day WHERE day >= 400 ORDER BY day

except Exception as e:
